This '''[[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]]''', during the [[Death Seed]] crisis of [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Quarantine Enforcement Cruiser]] ''[[Lycoming]]'', a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] belonging to the [[Coruscant Institute]]. She also had a Gotal [[chief medical officer]] named [[Tuuve]] with her. The captain received a distress call from the ''[[Empyrean]]'' which she responded to and discovered and arrested a group of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] led by [[Ugmush]]. Later, she also arrested [[Yarbolk Yemm]], an investigative [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]]. She ordered the captive to be thrown out of an airlock to protect [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]], which turned out to be responsible for the Death Seed outbreak.
